plugins.name: verify-loop
plugins.description: Verify Loop: one place to verify a change or claim. It writes a check that can fail, loops until the check passes, keeps the proof, and returns a fixed answer (verdict, VERIFY: line, observed rejection, gaps). Users, skills and agents can all call it. Create mode generates a project /verify skill; maintain mode keeps it honest as the app changes. Also ships feature-map (manual-only): a FEATURES.md of every feature, its entry points and traces, checked against the code and linked to VERIFY.md. And latent-audit (manual-only): dead code removed without breaking anything, in plain words: only code that is truly never loaded or called is deleted (not code loaded by a name built at runtime, a config or schedule, a plugin or an entry point), every command is rerun after, every suspect left gets a dead, live or watch verdict kept for the next session, and imports that point up a declared layer order are listed. The install runs no hooks.
